verdict.rationale: Kling documents its own capabilities that come close to a script-driven presenter video. Text-to-video can co-generate speech with voice control (kling-docs-12, kling-docs-21), and the Elements system keeps a character's identity and voice consistent across shots (kling-docs-13), which approximates a custom presenter. Nothing in the evidence describes a dedicated avatar or presenter product, so the core story is only implied. Missing for 10: a stock avatar library, a paste-script-to-talking-presenter workflow, documented lip-sync or presenter mode, custom avatar creation from a person's likeness, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
